methods.name: MCP hypothesis_t_test on dataset columns with missing values and integer columns
methods.reference: stats::t.test (one-sample; Welch; paired), NA removed as t.test does
quantities: sample means / mean difference (one-sample, Welch, paired, Welch on Int64)
methods.tolerance: MCP text at print precision (Tol::printed: 6 decimals for t, p, CI and means, 2 for df)

methods.name: MCP hypothesis_cor_test (Pearson) on complete pairs
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 6 (< 100): estimate 1e-6, statistic and CI 1e-5 relative, p 1e-5 relative + 1e-12 absolute, df and n exact

methods.name: MCP hypothesis_ks_test, two-sample, on Int64 columns with missing values
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 38 (< 100): D 1e-5 relative; sizes exact

deviations.note: p2a is asymptotic with Stephens' correction (0.19563779265722031); R's exact p conditional on ties is 0.1565386776017454; not pinned

methods.name: MCP hypothesis_mood_test on a tie-free Int64 pair with missing values
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 27 (< 100): statistics 1e-5 relative, p 1e-5 relative + 1e-12 absolute, sizes exact

methods.name: MCP hypothesis handlers report the rows they drop (Bartlett, Kruskal-Wallis, oneway, Friedman, Quade, Wilcoxon, pairwise t/Wilcoxon, Shapiro-Wilk)
methods.reference: complete.cases over the columns each R function uses (bartlett.test, kruskal.test, oneway.test, friedman.test, quade.test, wilcox.test, pairwise.t.test, pairwise.wilcox.test, shapiro.test)
quantities: missing: n_total, n_used, n_dropped, by_column (counts of the R complete cases)
no missing key when nothing is dropped

methods.name: MCP hypothesis_prop_trend_test on integer count columns with a missing group
methods.reference: stats::prop.trend.test on the complete groups, each group keeping its score
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 6 (< 100): statistic 1e-5 relative, p 1e-5 relative + 1e-12 absolute, df and scores exact

methods.name: MCP stats_loglin on a long-form count table with missing labels and counts
methods.reference: stats::loglin(xtabs(cnt ~ f1 + f2 + f3), margin, fit = TRUE) (xtabs drops rows with a missing label or count)
quantities: factor levels in R factor order
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 448 counts: statistics 1e-6 relative, p 1e-6 relative + 1e-12 absolute, df, dimensions and total exact

methods.name: MCP stats_weighted_mean (complete value/weight pairs) and stats_cov_wt (integer columns)
methods.reference: stats::weighted.mean on complete.cases(v, w); stats::cov.wt(cor = TRUE, method = 'unbiased' | 'ML')
quantities: refusal of missing values and weights
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 10-12 (< 100): weighted means, centres, sums of weights and normalised weights 1e-6, covariances and correlations 1e-5 relative; counts exact

deviations.note: the tool uses center to switch the correlation matrix and always centres the data (R cov.wt(center = FALSE) does not); pinned only with center omitted
